mechanism.claim: A large completed premium-index impulse that persists for a second hour while BTC first under-responds and then begins a small same-direction response identifies derivative demand that price has only partly assimilated. Follow the premium direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the early completed-hour premium-index close-minus-open change
mechanism.why_distinct: PPLAR measures cross-surface temporal transmission: an early premium impulse, premium persistence, initial BTC under-response, and a bounded delayed BTC assimilation. It is not premium compression, premium snapback, same-hour premium acceleration, funding, OI, implied volatility, or a fitted model.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: delayed premium-to-price assimilation is intended to isolate directional derivative demand during volatile auctions; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: top-quintile premium impulses with two-hour causal assimilation onsets and an eight-hour reservation

features.early_window: E=[D-2h,D-1h), exactly 60 coherent one-minute premium and BTC bars
features.late_window: L=[D-1h,D), exactly 60 coherent one-minute premium and BTC bars
features.early_premium_change: p_E=premium_close(E)-premium_open(E), strict nonzero; differences are used because premium may cross zero
features.prior_statistics: strict-prior histories over at most 540 valid exact two-hour decisions, minimum 360, current excluded: midranks of abs(p_E) and abs(r_E), plus median abs(r_L)
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding exact two-hour decision eligible state false
features.source_valid: complete unique coherent minute grids in both tables, finite BTC positive OHLC and finite premium OHLC; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: exact two-hour UTC boundary after E and L complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.premium_persistence_without_underrespons: retain premium impulse/persistence and delayed same-direction BTC response but omit early BTC rank<=0.40
definitions.contemporaneous_agreement: top-quintile abs(p_L) with sign(r_L)=sign(p_L), onset, side=sign(p_L)
definitions.one_hour_stale_premium: replace p_E and p_L by completed premium changes over [D-3h,D-2h) and [D-2h,D-1h), retain the primary current BTC E/L terms, prior statistics, eligibility, onset, and side=sign(stale p_E)

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no window, transmission bound, rank, median, onset, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
